reviews.review_msg: Dr. Guiry served as the ARCH100's administrator rather than the author, so his teaching style isn't applicable here. That said, he was consistently prompt and helpful in addressing questions and material errors. Quick to respond and easy to reach. A great administrator overall!

I took this class online summer intercession. The lectures were extremely dull (the prof had a monotone voice) and there was a lot of course content. If the prof had a better teaching strategy, the course could've been much better. The online exams also had very specific questions. DO NOT take if you want a GPA booster; do not recommend whatsoever.

Eric is a super caring and easygoing prof. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and will take time to go over topics and reaffirm your understanding. His attitude and mindset were especially helpful for ARCH376, as it's an upper-level Quant course, and I struggled with stats. Bonus points, He looks like an academic Matt Damon

Eric was awesome, he always gave you every opportunity to succeed, made things accessible, and was very clear and knowledgeable, was always willing to chat when he was in his office. Put in the work and you'll do well.
P.S. you gotta love the suspenders.
